svg.title: Knowledge graphs make facts explicit and queryable
svg.desc: Knowledge graphs store subject-relation-object triples and support exact multi-hop joins. Link prediction scores candidate triples (TransE uses low distance between s+r and o). Retrieved subgraphs can ground LLM answers, but knowledge graphs are incomplete.

g.text: Knowledge graphs make facts explicit and queryable
Triples support multi-hop joins; scoring models estimate missing links; graphs remain incomplete.
FACTS AS TRIPLES · ANSWER A MULTI-HOP QUESTION
TransE: low ‖s + r − o‖ → likely triple.
Editable facts guard against hallucination; coverage is incomplete.
